name: Uneed
conditions: Free 'Join the line' launch: Uneed assigns your launch date, up to 5 months out
The launch must reach an upvote score of 10 to stay published, and 20 for the do-follow backlink (upvotes weighted by each voter's multiplier)
Account required to save the product — the submit page scrapes your URL first, then asks you to sign up

sources.title: Uneed submit page — 'robots gather your product data', name + URL entry, signup-to-save
Uneed pricing — free line vs Skip the line $29.99 / Fast-track $14.99 / Relaunch $15, upvote thresholds
Uneed homepage — social launchpad positioning, 75DR do-follow backlink claims

requirements: Tech product / indie product — categories: development, design, marketing, business, personal life, products-for-sale
A public product URL the scraper can read
For the free route: enough launch-day upvotes (score 10 to stay published, 20 for do-follow backlink)
preparation: Product name and URL (the site auto-scrapes product data — make sure your landing page has good OG meta, logo, and copy)
An account (signup happens mid-flow, after the scrape)
A plan to mobilize upvotes on launch day — free launches can be unpublished if the upvote threshold isn't met
Optional budget: Skip the line $29.99 (choose launch date, guaranteed do-follow), Fast-track $14.99 (slot in ~14 days, do-follow at score 10), Relaunch $15 for existing products
workflow: Enter product name and product address; click 'Preview my product' so their scraper pulls page data
Create/sign into an account to save the submission
Choose 'Join the line' (free) or a paid option
For the free line: wait for the assigned launch date (up to ~5 months), then drive upvotes on launch day
Verify the product page is live under uneed.best/tool/<name> and whether the do-follow backlink threshold was met
watchFor: Free launches can be unpublished if they miss the upvote score — the free path is genuinely gated by community performance, not just a queue
Vote multiplier mechanics mean votes from established/Pro members count more
Heavy paid upsell surface: ads ($197–399/mo), newsletter sponsorship $399, $249 auto-submit-to-100-directories, public product review $147
'Early bird' Pro subscription $99/year — early bird spots showed as sold out at fetch time
Anti-cheating enforcement is advertised (Thomas removes vote manipulation)
countsAsLive: A public product page at uneed.best/tool/<name> that survived launch day (score >=10), appearing in category/tag listings; do-follow backlink active once score >=20 or paid option used
unknowns: Exact weighting rules for the voter multiplier
Current free-queue wait (stated ceiling is 5 months)
Whether the scraped preview can be edited before saving
